jobs.title: Manager - SEO
jobs.description:
**Management Level:** 7 -Manager - SEO
  
  
**Location:** Hyderabad
  
  
**Must have skills:** SEO Strategy, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), Organic Growth, Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  
**Good to have skills:** Education Industry SEO, Content Strategy, Technical SEO, Analytics & Performance Tracking, Agency Management
  
  
**Experience:** 12-15 years of experience is required
  
  
**Educational Qualification:** Graduate (Marketing, Business Administration, or related fields preferred)
  
  
Job Overview
  
  
The Manager - SEO is responsible for designing and executing a holistic SEO, AEO, and GEO strategy to drive organic growth, enhance search visibility, and scale lead generation for LearnVantage programs across India and new markets. This role involves leading search initiatives for an expanding portfolio of certificate and degree programs in collaboration with premier institutions like IIMs and IITs. It requires partnering with content, product, analytics, and agency teams to strengthen AI discoverability and maximize business impact.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
Lead and execute the overall SEO, AEO, and GEO strategy for LearnVantage programs, driving organic growth across India and new international markets.
  
  
Strengthen AI discoverability and search visibility by optimizing content for modern search intent, answer engines, and generative AI platforms.
  
  
Partner closely with content, product, analytics, and external agency teams to align organic initiatives with broader business objectives.
  
  
Drive organic lead generation and maximize business impact to support our expanding academic portfolio.
  
  
Track and analyze organic performance metrics, providing actionable insights to continually refine and scale search strategies.
  
  
**Required Experience, Skills and Qualifications:**  
12 to 15 years of proven experience in driving successful search engine optimization and digital growth strategies.
  
  
Strong command over traditional SEO alongside emerging focus areas like AEO and GEO.
  
  
Prior experience handling education, tech, or digital program portfolios, with collaborations involving academic institutions being a strong plus.
  
  
Excellent cross-functional collaboration, analytical thinking, and strategic execution capabilities.
  
  
About Us
  
  
Backed by a $1 billion investment over three years, Accenture launched its LearnVantage business in March 2024, providing comprehensive learning and training services to help organizations reskill and upskill their people and achieve greater business results in the AI economy. Powered by an AI-native platform, Accenture LearnVantage offers learning strategy and design, personalized learning experiences, learning managed services and certifications, all supported by a robust partner network and access to more than 2,000 mentors around the world.
  
  
For more information, please visit www.accenture.com/learnvantage

jobs.description:
About Signant Health
  
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Why Signant Health?

* The ability to mentor engineers and guide them through design, planning, and execution.

jobs.title: Formulation Product Development Manager
jobs.description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**JOB PURPOSE:**

Provide senior individual-contributor technical leadership for OTC formulation science, product design, development, scale-up, technology transfer, regulatory technical support, and lifecycle management across consumer healthcare products and dosage forms.

The Principal Scientist, OTC Formulation is a individual-contributor technical authority responsible for shaping formulation strategy and resolving complex technical challenges across OTC consumer healthcare development programs. The role reports to the Senior Principal Scientist, OTC Product Development / Formulation Science, and operates through technical depth, cross-functional influence, senior review, governance, and mentorship rather than direct line management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Formulation and Product Development**

* Define formulation strategy and technical development approach for complex OTC products across relevant consumer healthcare categories.

* Translate consumer, commercial, regulatory, quality, and manufacturing requirements into robust target product profiles and formulation strategies.

* Provide senior technical leadership for dosage-form design, pre-formulation, excipient selection, active compatibility, product performance, and risk-based formulation decisions.

* Resolve complex formulation challenges including palatability, dose delivery, solubility, dissolution, rheology, microbial robustness, preservative effectiveness, packaging interaction, and stability.

Embed QbD, design of experiments, critical quality attributes, critical process parameters, control strategy, and technical risk management into development programs.  



2. **Technical Leadership and Delivery**

* Ensure formulation decisions support consumer experience, labelled use, dose delivery, product performance, and OTC self-care suitability.

* Partner with Medical, Regulatory, Claims, Consumer Science, Commercial, Quality, Packaging, Supply, and external partners to support evidence readiness and product delivery.

* Provide technical review of formulation rationale, development data, stability conclusions, regulatory technical content, and lifecycle change assessments.

Contribute to innovation, external technology assessment, competitive benchmarking, design-to-value, productivity, sustainability, and lifecycle improvement opportunities.  



**Why you?**

**Basic Qualifications:**

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:

* Master’s degree in Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent senior technical experience may be considered.

* Typically 8-10+ years of formulation, product development, or technical leadership experience in OTC, consumer healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other regulated product environments.

* Demonstrated accountability for formulation strategy, technical problem solving, and delivery of multiple products, platforms, dosage forms, or lifecycle programs.

Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, work with external partners, and coach or mentor scientists through technical authority rather than formal line-management authority.  



**Preferred Qualifications:**

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

* Experience supporting multiple geographic markets, APAC regulatory environments, or OTC monograph/local-standard frameworks.

* Experience with pain, respiratory, allergy, gastrointestinal, dermatology, wellness, or adjacent self-care categories.

* Experience with contract development or manufacturing organizations, external laboratories, packaging partners, or external innovation partners.

Knowledge of QbD, design of experiments, technical risk assessment, design-to-value, sustainability, and structured problem-solving tools.  



**Core Competencies:**

* Strategic formulation leadership and advanced scientific judgment.

* Complex technical problem solving and risk-based decision making.

* Cross-functional influence and stakeholder management.

* Clear technical communication, documentation, and governance mindset.

* Knowledge sharing, and capability building as an individual contributor.

Consumer-focused innovation, business acumen, and continuous improvement mindset.  



**Key Performance Indicators**

* Quality and impact of formulation strategy, technical direction, and risk-based decisions.

* Delivery of key technical milestones across development, scale-up, launch, and lifecycle programs.

* Robustness, stability, manufacturability, scalability, and consumer acceptability of developed products.

* Resolution of complex formulation, process, analytical, packaging, stability, and manufacturing issues.

* Quality of technical documentation, regulatory support, control strategy, and lifecycle change assessments.

Contribution to innovation, productivity, sustainability, external technology assessment, and formulation-science capability building.

**Description**

At Ness, people come first. Here, you'll be part of a vibrant team that values curiosity, innovation, and growth. We work with industry-leading clients on projects that truly make an impact while supporting every team member in carving out their unique career path. With resources for learning, certifications, and hands-on experiences, Ness offers you more than just a job—it’s a place where your ideas, ambition, and well-being matter.

### 

### **The Role**

### **We are looking for a Senior Java Full Stack Developer to join our engineering team and contribute to the development of scalable, high-performance enterprise applications. This role involves hands-on development, mentoring team members, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver robust solutions across front-end and back-end systems.**

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain full stack applications using Java and modern front-end frameworks.
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable and efficient technical solutions.
* Write clean, efficient, and testable code aligned with development standards and best practices.
* Participate in architectural discussions, design reviews, and code reviews.
* Guide junior team members by sharing technical expertise and best practices.

### **Qualifications and Skills**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking with a results-driven mindset.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Passionate about clean code, performance optimization, and software quality.
* Comfortable working in Agile/Scrum development environments.

### **Core Skills**

* 6–9 years of professional experience in Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful microservices.
* Hands-on experience with Angular (v2+) or React.js for front-end development.
* Solid understanding of design patterns, data structures, and object-oriented principles.
* Experience working with RDBMS (Oracle, SQL Server, or PostgreSQL).
* Proficiency in tools like Git, Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps workflows.
* Experience deploying applications on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) is preferred.

### **Nice to Have**

* Exposure to system observability/monitoring tools.

* Familiarity with unit testing (JUnit/TestNG), E2E testing, and automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of messaging systems like IBM MQ or Redis Cache.

* Hands-on experience with modern front-end frameworks like Angular (v2+) or React.js.
* Solid understanding of design patterns, data structures, and object-oriented principles.
* Skilled in working with RDBMS (Oracle, SQL Server, or PostgreSQL) and writing optimized queries.
* Proficient in DevOps tools such as Git, Jenkins, and CI/CD pipelines, with experience deploying applications on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and performance tuning for enterprise applications.
* Comfortable participating in architectural discussions, mentoring junior developers, and collaborating in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Bonus: Experience with system observability tools, financial domain projects, messaging systems (IBM MQ, Redis), and automated testing frameworks.

**Why Join Us**  
At Ness, you will work with diverse, talented professionals who are dedicated to making an impact through technology. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement, we’d love to connect with you if this role excites you. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace that celebrates each team member’s unique talents.

**What to Expect Next**

We believe great experiences start with transparency—and that includes our hiring process. Here’s what you can typically expect after you hit "Apply":

1. HR Interview – A conversation to get to know you better and align on expectations.

2. Technical Interview – A chance to showcase your skills and experience.

3. Client Interview – Ensuring mutual fit between you and the client team.

4. Offer Stage – If everything aligns, we’ll be happy to make it official.

**While many of our roles involve just 2–3 steps, some client processes may include additional conversations. Regardless of the path, we aim to keep every step transparent and respectful of your time.**

jobs.description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Digital Product Manager, to join the AI & Data Innovation Lab Product Management Team. This role is focused on rapidly validating high-potential AI and data-driven business opportunities before major investment, helping Amgen determine which AI initiatives should be scaled, refined, paused, or redirected.
  
  
Operating at the intersection of business strategy, AI product innovation, data, technology, and enterprise transformation, this role will provide strategic product leadership across ambiguous, cross-functional opportunities and influence senior business and technology stakeholders on product direction, prioritization, investment, and scale.
  
  
This role requires a strong product mindset, sufficient technical depth to evaluate whether AI and data opportunities are practical, scalable, measurable, and aligned to Amgen’s enterprise technology direction. The successful candidate will understand how AI products are built, validated, deployed, monitored, and scaled in complex enterprise environments.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design and execute rapid discovery sprints, prototypes, pilots, user research, and experiments to assess desirability, feasibility, viability, value, and risk. Use evidence to determine whether opportunities should advance, pivot, pause, or scale.
* Identify, frame, and validate AI-enabled business opportunities across Amgen. Translate broad transformation themes into clear problem statements, testable hypotheses, user needs, data requirements, success metrics, and validation plans.
* Assess how LLMs, AI agents, machine learning models, NLP, automation, knowledge retrieval, analytics, and intelligent workflow tools can improve productivity, decision quality, scientific discovery, operational efficiency, and workforce effectiveness.
* Evaluate whether proposed AI opportunities have the right data foundations, system integrations, architecture patterns, model capabilities, security controls, and operational support needed to move from concept to scalable solution.
* Partner with engineering, data science, and technical teams to align on scope, tradeoffs, and execution path.

jobs.title: Senior PMT
jobs.description:
**Description**
Our mission is to ensure customers trust Amazon to deliver a perfect order experience on every order. The Order Performance team within Perfect Order Experience (POE) is responsible for setting performance standards and ensuring that every purchase in our stores meets or exceeds Amazon's high bar for fulfillment quality and customer service quality — regardless of seller or channel. For our external selling partners, we set minimum performance expectations and enforce those expectations by limiting selling privileges if needed, while incentivizing sellers to improve performance and address customer pain points.
  
  
As a Senior Product Manager-Tech for Enforcement Decisioning, you will own the logic that determines when enforcement triggers — the threshold framework that translates seller performance metrics into enforcement decisions across all Order Performance policies and all global marketplaces. You will build intelligent, data-driven decisioning that calibrates enforcement to the tradeoff between customer harm prevented and seller value lost. You will also own the criteria for exemptions, leniency, and permanent enforcement, determining which sellers deserve differentiated treatment. You will partner with data scientists, software engineers, policy teams, and operations stakeholders to define the vision, design experiments, and ship decisioning systems that reduce order defects for hundreds of millions of customers while preserving the seller value that drives Amazon's flywheel.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for enforcement decisioning, including data-driven threshold models, exemption frameworks, permanent enforcement pathways, and graduated enforcement calibration across multiple fulfillment quality policies
* Make trade-off decisions across enforcement model design (segmentation, economic tradeoff curves, marketplace-specific vs. global calibration)
* Design and launch enforcement decisioning systems that maximize defect prevention while minimizing unnecessary enforcement of valuable selection
* Design exemption and leniency logic — including thresholds for high-value listings, enforcement leniency for sellers with sustained clean performance, and graduated protection mechanisms
* Run A/B and holdout experiments to measure the causal impact of threshold changes on customer experience and business metrics— translating experimental results into production rollout decisions
* Author the long-term enforcement strategy and present to senior leadership, contributing to annual planning cycles and writing strategy documents that align cross-functional stakeholders

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight

jobs.description:
**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

  

**1.** **Internal platform product roadmap**

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for CIMET's internal platform layer: the tools, consoles, dashboards, and workflow systems used by Operations, Finance, Partner Management, CX, and the Product team itself.
* Before defining what to build, map how the system works end-to-end: where data originates, how it moves between teams and tools, where it breaks or gets duplicated, and what the downstream consequences of each failure point are.
* Define what gets built, upgraded, automated, or eliminated. Prioritise based on system-level impact: not just time saved in one team, but friction and error removed from the broader operating chain.
* Maintain a live inventory of current internal tools and workflows with an honest assessment of what is working, what is broken, what is redundant, and what creates hidden dependencies that any change must account for.
* Set quarterly targets for workflow automation coverage and manual effort reduction, and report against them.

  

**2.** **System redesign before automation**

* Treat automation as the second step, not the first. Before any workflow is automated, establish whether the workflow is worth automating: is it structured correctly, does it have the right inputs, does it produce the right outputs, or does it need to be redesigned first?
* Map process interdependencies across teams before making changes. Understand what each workflow receives from upstream and delivers downstream, so that a change in one area does not create invisible breakage elsewhere.
* Identify where manual workarounds have become load-bearing: processes that exist only because a system gap was never fixed, that now have teams depending on them. These need redesign, not automation.
* Define data standards and workflow contracts at the system level: what information flows between teams, in what format, at what frequency, with what quality guarantees. Automation built without these contracts creates fragile pipelines.
* Own the transition from current state to redesigned state: sequencing changes so that teams are not left without working processes during the shift, and so that new automations land on a clean foundation.

  

**3.** **Automation and AI implementation**

* Identify and implement rules-based automation across high-frequency, high-friction internal workflows using n8n. Own the automation backlog end-to-end: scoping, requirement definition, implementation coordination, testing, and rollout.
* Identify where GenAI integration materially improves an internal workflow: document processing, lead quality assessment, report generation, exception triaging, or communication drafting. Specify the product requirements, not just the use case.
* Manage CIMET's internal agentic AI programme: multi-step workflows where AI agents take autonomous actions across systems. Define what agents should own, what their boundaries are, what the human-in-the-loop checkpoints are, and how failures are caught.

**6.** **Automation ROI tracking**

* This role is a critical execution counterpart to **Data Architecture and Data Analysis, Products & Integration**, building faithfully against their designs and requirements and compressing the path from new data to a production-grade, reusable asset. Rapid Build & Delivery

Silver — Build to Architecture’s Design

* Implement the design faithfully and promote it to production through **governed CI/CD pipelines**.
* Capture **business context and metadata** at build, and hand off to trusted partner teams as readiness allows.

Gold — Democratized, Delivered Through MVP

* Treat the Gold layer as **democratized** — Data Operations may own specific Gold assets and assists other teams in building theirs.
* Deliver Gold solutions through **build-through-MVP**, promoted to production-grade through governed CI/CD pipelines regardless of owner.
* Uphold the **build standards and guardrails** any Gold solution must meet, so a federated Gold layer stays stable and production-grade across owning teams.

Engineering Discipline & Production Readiness

* Build to **production standards** from day one so the lift from MVP to production is simple, not a rebuild.
* Apply consistent **development patterns, naming conventions, and build standards** with specific focus on the connectivity across all data products to create a more connected data ecosystem.
* Move work through the CI/CD pipeline — develop, test, and productionize — clearing **quality, security, and cost checks** on first pass.
* Apply **AI and automation** to accelerate build and testing without bypassing governance, security, or quality expectations.

Partnership & Collaboration

* Partner with **Data Architecture** — building to their Silver design and co-designing Gold within the standards they set.
* Partner with **Data Analysis, Products & Integration** — who bring the requirements, business rules, and acceptance criteria this role builds against.
* Partner with **Platform Engineering / IT and DevOps & AI Enablement** — who own ingestion, pipelines, and the automation frameworks this role builds on.
* Partner with **data science and business analytics teams** so Gold data products serve their models, analyses, and decisions.
* Partner with **data governance teams** to ensure enterprise standards are consistently implemented
* Set the design and hold Data Operations standards across **the Hyderabad Data Operations team** and **outside service partners** as part of a global delivery model.

What This Role Is Not

* Not a pure data engineering or platform role.
* Not the owner of the enterprise Silver model.
* Not the primary business-engagement or requirements role.
* Not the owner of the Gold layer, which is democratized across teams.
* Not a governance policy, stewardship, or BI reporting role.
* This role exists to **build real data solutions that get used** — designed for the business, engineered to last, delivered through MVP.

**Role Summary & Role Description**

The role is responsible for building, validating, maintaining, and governing end‑to‑end service maps within the CMDB to ensure accurate visibility of business services and their underlying application and infrastructure dependencies. The role supports operational resilience, regulatory compliance (including DORA), incident and change impact analysis, and ongoing BAU governance by ensuring service maps meet defined quality, completeness, and freshness standards.

This role works closely with Application Owners, SMEs, Discovery teams, ServiceNow Operations, and Governance stakeholders to ensure service mapping data is accurate, auditable, and fit for operational and regulatory use cases.

  
  

**Service Mapping & CMDB Management**

* Create, enhance, and maintain business service and application service maps using ServiceNow Service Mapping and Discovery capabilities.
* Validate relationships between business services, applications, and underlying configuration items (servers, databases, load balancers, networks, cloud resources).
* Ensure service maps follow approved mapping standards, rubrics, and SOPs.
* Build, maintain, and optimize service maps using a combination of pattern based (top-down) and automated discovery techniques (e.g. Tag based), starting from defined application entry points (URL, IP, load balancer) and leveraging ML assisted, traffic based dependency detection to automatically identify, validate, and maintain accurate end to end service relationships across applications and infrastructure.
* Identify and remediate gaps such as missing relationships, incorrect dependency paths, stale or orphaned CIs.
* Coordinate with Discovery and Infrastructure teams to resolve discovery gaps, CI inaccuracies, and integration issues.
* Perform map validation sessions with Application Owners and SMEs to confirm technical and business accuracy.
* Support iterative refinement cycles and health reviews of service maps.
* Monitor data freshness, CI health, and mapping quality metrics.
  

  

**Governance, BAU, Compliance & Automation**

* Support BAU service mapping governance, including tier based recertification cycles and evidence collection.
* Track exceptions, remediation actions, and stakeholder responses related to service map validation.
* Maintain audit ready documentation and evidence to support regulatory and internal control requirements (e.g., DORA).
* Contribute to KPI reporting, dashboards, and management updates on mapping coverage and quality.
* Contribute to ITAM automation by identifying repeatable asset management tasks and supporting automation enhancements that improve data accuracy, lifecycle visibility, and operational efficiency across the asset estate.
* Collaborate cross functionally to identify, prioritize, and deliver automation enhancements, ensuring solutions are scalable, platform aligned, and support BAU efficiency, governance, and audit readiness.
  

  

**Core/Must have skills**

Strong understanding of Service Mapping concepts, CMDB, and dependency mapping.

Hands‑on experience with ServiceNow (Service Mapping, Discovery, CMDB).

Experience with tag-based service mapping and meta data driven mapping approaches, particularly in cloud environments.

Understanding of IT infrastructure components (servers, databases, networks, cloud services).

Familiarity with ITSM processes (Incident, Change, Problem).

  
  

**Good to have skills**

ServiceNow Certification (CSA, CIS.SM)

Familiarity with improving mapping outcomes through pattern optimization or extension concepts (where applicable)

Understanding of MID Server setup, health monitoring, and discovery troubleshooting.

**Work Schedule**

Hybrid

**Keywords (If any)**

Service mapping, CMDB, ServiceNow Discovery

**Location**

Hyderabad, Bangalore, Pune

jobs.description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
Join a new team with the ambition to build ServiceNow’s Accounts Receivable Operations (ARO) product from an emerging opportunity into a $100M business.
  
  
We are bringing new ways of working to finance—using AI to help enterprises accelerate collections, resolve disputes, improve cash flow, and reduce manual work. This is an opportunity to help shape a new product, establish how a new team works, and grow ServiceNow’s presence in a new market.
  
  
We are looking for an inbound product leader who combines enterprise software experience with a strong understanding of finance operations, especially accounts receivable. You will work directly with customers and closely with engineering, design, and research to turn complex financial processes into intuitive products and AI-powered workflows. You should enjoy building from the ground up, working through ambiguity, and taking ownership from initial discovery through delivery and adoption.
  
  
**What You Get To Do In This Role**

* Own product strategy, priorities, and roadmap for Accounts Receivable Operations, helping establish ARO as a strategic growth business for ServiceNow.
* Partner with finance leaders, AR managers, and collections teams to understand their challenges and identify opportunities to improve collections, dispute resolution, and the broader invoice-to-cash process.
* Define AI-native capabilities that capture an organization’s collections expertise and apply it to prioritizing work, engaging customers, and autonomously resolving routine tasks and cases.
* Translate customer needs and complex finance workflows into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with engineering, design, research, and platform teams to guide development and bring high-quality products to market.
* Integrate customer discovery, usability studies, market analysis, and competitive insights into product decisions.
* Partner with early customers to validate solutions, guide pilots and adoption, and turn lessons learned into capabilities that serve the broader market.
* Define and measure product success through customer outcomes such as faster collections, reduced days sales outstanding, improved collector productivity, and shorter dispute resolution times.
* Communicate product priorities and tradeoffs clearly, build consensus, and influence stakeholders across organizational boundaries.
* Help establish the team’s ways of working, including using AI to accelerate discovery, improve decisions, and strengthen execution.
* Take accountability for outcomes across the product lifecycle and coach other product managers as the team grows.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
* 8+ years of software product management experience, including ownership of enterprise products from discovery through launch and adoption.
* Experience building products for finance operations, with direct experience in accounts receivable, collections, dispute management, or invoice-to-cash strongly preferred.
* A strong understanding of how finance teams operate, including their workflows, performance measures, financial controls, and relationships with customers and other business functions.
* An understanding of how finance workflow products connect with ERP systems and other sources of customer, invoice, payment, and account data.
* Experience defining product requirements and translating them into a prioritized roadmap and actionable development plans.
* Deep curiosity about customer needs and a track record of building relationships with business leaders and practitioners to deliver customer-centered solutions.
* Strong prioritization skills and the discipline to focus on the activities that create the greatest customer and business impact.
* The ability to connect a broader product vision with the details required to deliver a complete, usable solution.
* An entrepreneurial mindset, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to establish direction and deliver results in a new product or market.
* Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to explain complex problems clearly to technical, business, and executive audiences.
* The ability to lead across functions, coach less experienced colleagues, and build a culture of ownership, learning, and execution.

jobs.description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.

  

By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications.  We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.

**Role Overview:**
  

PDI Technologies is looking for a Product Owner to help drive our mobile product roadmap from vision to delivery. This individual will take roadmap initiatives and solution briefs and break them down into clear, well-structured PRDs that our engineering teams can pick up and execute against — keeping delivery moving in a fast-paced, iterative environment.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Product Owner (PO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is accountable for the end‑to‑end ownership, delivery, and adoption of enterprise data products. This role serves as the single point of accountability for product vision, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, and experience quality across assigned data domains.
  
  
The Product Owner partners closely with
**Business stakeholders, Data Engineering, BI/Reporting, Data Science, Governance, and Platform teams**
to ensure data products are reliable, intuitive, scalable, and aligned with Kroll’s strategic priorities. The role emphasizes
**clarity of ownership, predictable delivery, and measurable business impact**
in a complex, enterprise data environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership & Accountability**

* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for enterprise data, analytics, or AI product areas.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for product outcomes, delivery health, and user experience.
* Define and communicate product goals, success metrics, and value drivers to stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Ensure products operate with clear ownership, release discipline, and lifecycle management, behaving like true products—not one‑off projects.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Business Alignment**

* Act as the primary interface between the CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Partner with stakeholders to prioritize demand, manage tradeoffs, and align delivery to business timelines.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements without compromising data integrity or architectural standards.
* Establish and maintain trusted relationships that enable fast decision‑making and alignment.

**Backlog, Roadmap & Delivery Management**

* Own and maintain a prioritized, well‑defined backlog with clear acceptance criteria and readiness standards.
* Work with Program Managers, Scrum Masters, and delivery teams to plan releases and manage dependencies.
* Balance short‑term delivery needs with long‑term product health, scalability, and maintainability.
* Surface risks, constraints, or scope trade‑offs early to enable leadership decisions.

**Governance, Quality & Standards**

* Partner with Data Governance, Data Stewards, and Platform Owners to ensure:

+ Consistent KPI definitions and metric logic
+ Data quality, lineage, and trust standards
+ Alignment with enterprise data architecture and security policies

* Ensure products meet operational readiness standards prior to release and are supported post‑launch.

**Adoption, Value & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive product adoption by ensuring solutions is intuitive, reliable, and aligned to real user workflows.
* Define and track usage, adoption, and value realization metrics.
* Collect feedback and iterate to continuously improve product experience and impact.
* Support leadership by providing a clear narrative on what is delivered, what value it creates, and what comes next.

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Analytics, or Data‑centric roles.
* Proven ability to own roadmaps, backlogs, and stakeholder relationships in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of data, reporting, analytics, or BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks, data warehouses).
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models with engineering and analytics teams.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate between business objectives and technical execution.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a Chief Data Office, Analytics, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with data governance, semantic models, KPI standardization, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience supporting finance, operations, or enterprise‑wide reporting domains.
* Prior experience working in a vendor‑heavy environment and helping transition to more internal ownership.

**Leadership Behaviors & Expectations**

* Operates with clear ownership and accountability.
* Brings structure, clarity, and discipline to ambiguous problem spaces.
* Makes trade‑offs explicitly and escalates decisions appropriately.
* Focuses on outcomes and value, not just delivery.
* Trusted partner to both business leaders and technical teams.

**Why This Role Matters**
The Product Owner is a
**critical enabler of CDO’s product‑led operating model**
, ensuring that data and analytics investments deliver consistent, trusted, and measurable value to the firm—while reducing dependency on informal workarounds, fragmented ownership, and vendor‑driven execution.

jobs.description:
**Job Title: Product Manager / Product Owner Billing & Revenue Cycle**

  

**Location: India**

  

**About the Company**

  

First Insight is a leading healthcare technology company headquartered in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, USA. With more than 30 years of innovation and industry leadership, First Insight serves over 2,000 eye care professionals nationwide through a fully integrated technology platform.

In 1994, First Insight became the first company to introduce a fully integrated EHR, Practice Management, and Optical Management solution specifically designed for optometrists and ophthalmologists helping redefine operational excellence in eye care practices.

  

Today, our global team of more than 300 professionals operates across the United States and India. Our product ecosystem includes:

  

* MaximEyes Industry-leading EHR, Practice Management, and Optical Software
* Fast Pay Health Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and Billing Services
* EVAA AI-powered workflow automation and intelligence platform

  

We are committed to improving patient outcomes, increasing practice efficiency, and driving financial performance for healthcare providers through innovative technology and exceptional service.

  

Join a company that combines deep healthcare expertise, cutting-edge technology, and a mission-driven culture focused on transforming eye care.

  

To learn more, visit: www.first-insight.com

  

**Job Summary**

  

The Product Manager / Product Owner Billing & Revenue Cycle will own and continuously improve the billing capabilities of MaximEyes, First Insight’s EHR and Practice Management System, while also playing a key product role in EVAA Billing Assistant, the company’s AI- and RPA-powered billing automation platform.The role will have a strong mandate to harness AI and intelligent automation to make billing workflows faster, more accurate, more predictive, and increasingly touchless.

  

This is a highly hands-on product role requiring deep expertise in the U.S. healthcare billing lifecycle, preferably within optometry and ophthalmology. The successful candidate will identify billing product issues, define solutions, write detailed requirements, work closely with engineering and QA, validate fixes, and continuously look for opportunities to use AI, automation, workflow intelligence, and data-driven decisioning to eliminate manual work and improve billing outcomes.

  

The role will also help build EVAA Billing Assistant into a scalable, AI-first automation platform capable of integrating with MaximEyes and other leading eye-care EHR/PMS platforms used in the market. The goal is to automate as much of the end-to-end billing lifecycle as practical while retaining appropriate human oversight for exceptions and high-risk decisions.

  

The ideal candidate combines deep billing subject-matter expertise with EHR/PMS product management, product ownership, healthcare workflow knowledge, and a strong understanding of how AI, RPA, APIs, intelligent agents, and workflow automation can be applied to healthcare billing.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own and maintain the billing product roadmap for MaximEyes and related First Insight products, prioritizing enhancements based on customer impact, revenue impact, operational efficiency, regulatory requirements, strategic importance, and the opportunity to leverage AI and automation to remove repetitive work.

  

* Serve as the primary billing subject-matter expert and product owner for MaximEyes, with deep knowledge of patient registration, insurance, eligibility, benefits, authorization, charge capture, coding, claims, clearinghouse workflows, rejections, denials, corrections, secondary billing, coordination of benefits, payment posting, ERA/EOB, patient responsibility, adjustments, refunds, A/R, aging, follow-up, unused benefits, reconciliation, statements, and reporting.

* Own the product development of EVAA Billing Assistant, including eligibility verification, benefits verification, unused benefits verification, claim preparation and submission, claim-status checking, rejection handling, claim correction and resubmission, payment posting, ERA/EOB processing, reconciliation, A/R workflows, denials, and automated follow-up, with a focus on maximizing the percentage of these activities that can be intelligently automated.

  

* Determine which billing processes should be automated using AI, intelligent agents, RPA, rules-based automation, APIs, or a combination of technologies. Define where AI can interpret information, make recommendations or decisions, predict outcomes, detect anomalies, and initiate actions, while establishing appropriate human-in-the-loop controls, auditability, and exception-handling processes.

  

* Build a practical AI-first product strategy for billing: identify repetitive, rules-heavy, data-heavy, and exception-driven workflows that can be transformed into intelligent agents and automated processes; define measurable targets for touchless processing, accuracy, cycle time, and revenue impact; and continuously learn from production data to improve automation.

  

* Work with engineering, AI/ML, and integration teams to design EVAA integrations across MaximEyes, RevolutionEHR, Compulink, OfficeMate, Eyefinity, ModMed, Acuity Logic, and other relevant EHR/PMS platforms, using APIs, automation, AI agents, and other integration methods wherever practical.

  

* Understand how billing data flows between EHR/PMS systems, clearinghouses, payers, RCM platforms, payment systems,…

**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview:**

LPL Financial is seeking a Data Product Analyst to support our Strategic Data Platforms, with a strong focus on how data is produced, shaped, governed, and delivered to downstream consumers across the firm.

This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Data Product Ownership, and Advanced Analysis, and is designed for a senior individual contributor who can bring rigor and clarity to complex, data‑centric platform initiatives.

The Data Product Analyst focuses on data as a product—helping define data contracts, validate quality, assess downstream impact, and support data product and platform decisions.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across upstream systems of record, platform services, and downstream consumers, and excels at turning complex data flows into actionable insights and decisions.

**Responsibilities:**

Product Discovery & Capability Support

* Support product discovery by helping translate business and platform needs into clear data‑centric problem statements.

* Contribute to roadmap planning by evaluating value, risk, and complexity across data initiatives.

* Help define outcomes and success measures for data platform capabilities (e.g., usability, reliability, adoption, quality).

Advanced Data Analysis & Problem Solving

* Perform hands‑on exploratory and diagnostic analysis across distributed data sources and platforms.

* Investigate data quality issues, lineage gaps, and semantic inconsistencies that affect downstream consumers.

* Conduct impact analysis for schema changes, new feeds, platform migrations, or system decommissions.

* Identify systemic issues in data flow, transformation, or consumption and recommend durable solutions.

Data Product Ownership (Supporting / Platform‑Level)

* Support Data Product Owners by helping define:

* Data contracts, schemas, and semantic definitions

* Data quality rules, validation logic, and controls

* Usage expectations and downstream dependencies

* Maintain traceability between business intent, data products, and technical implementation.

* Partner with engineering, architecture, and data platform teams to support scalable, reusable distribution patterns.

Agile Execution & Delivery

* Contribute to Jira artifacts (features, stories, acceptance criteria) with strong data and platform context.

* Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demos to ensure work reflects validated platform and consumer needs.

* Support prioritization decisions by providing evidence‑based impact and dependency analysis.

Stakeholder Communication & Influence

* Act as an analytical partner to Product Managers, Platform Owners, Engineering, and downstream consumer teams.

* Communicate complex data flow and platform concepts in clear, decision‑ready narratives.

* Help align stakeholders across domains by grounding conversations in data realities and trade‑offs.

**What are we looking for?**

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

**Requirements:**

* 4+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analysis, Data Product Ownership, or Platform‑oriented Product roles.

* Strong hands‑on experience with SQL (advanced querying, joins, performance awareness)

* Experience working with data platforms, distributed data systems, or integration layers.

* Experience adopting emerging AI‑enabled capabilities to improve the speed, depth, and effectiveness of data analysis

* Experience operating in Agile/Scrum environments with cross‑functional product and engineering teams.

* Proven ability to work across ambiguity and translate complex data ecosystems into actionable insights.

* Solid understanding of:

* Data modeling and semantic consistency

* Data quality, lineage, and governance concepts

* Pipelines, and event‑driven architectures (conceptual and analytical understanding)

**Preferences****:**

* Experience supporting advisor data platforms, or shared enterprise data services.

* Background in financial services, wealth management, or other highly regulated data environments.

**Core Competencies****:**

* Familiarity with downstream consumer needs (applications, analytics platforms, partners, regulatory consumers).
* Experience performing impact analysis for data changes across multiple consuming systems.

Compliance, Conduct and Operational Risk plays a critical role in the successful execution of the firm's Compliance, Conduct and Operational Risk mission. You will partner with stakeholders across Business, Finance, Digitalization, Operations and Technology groups to gather and document requirements and support change management activities. You will work with Technology partners to review business requirements and prioritize work for sprint planning using JIRA. **About Us**

Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities.

**Job Summary**

* The Business Analyst, Implementations will work closely with both client IT teams and internal technical teams to acquire, configure, and integrate healthcare data for revenue cycle management projects. This role involves data mapping, building data parsers, and ensuring internal systems are customized to meet client requirements. The ideal candidate will bridge functional and technical needs, ensuring seamless data flow and successful project delivery.

**Essential Functions and Tasks**

* Collaborate with client IT teams to acquire healthcare data feeds (e.g., patient demographics, medical records, case logs, etc.) for revenue cycle management, and gather data/system configuration requirements to pass on to internal IT teams.
* Develop and maintain data mapping specifications, ensuring proper data transformation and structure for integration into internal systems.
* Provide internal IT teams with clear specifications for system configuration, data parsers, and custom workflows to meet client requirements.
* Work with internal teams to ensure data parsers are built, optimized, and tested to maintain data integrity and compatibility with internal systems.
* Coordinate and oversee testing of data integration and system configurations, ensuring all requirements are met and discrepancies resolved.
* Serve as the primary liaison between client IT teams, internal implementation teams, and IT teams, ensuring smooth communication and alignment on project goals.
* Document system configurations, data mappings, and workflows for future reference and alignment between client and internal systems.
* Troubleshoot and resolve data integration issues in collaboration with internal IT teams, ensuring timely and accurate resolution.
* Identify and implement opportunities to optimize system configurations, data parsers, and integration workflows for efficiency and faster delivery.

**Role & responsibilities**

**Role -Business Analyst( Health Care Domain)**

**If interested send me cv on 6304776536 or bommakanti.sai.vaidehi@pwc.com**

**Preferred candidate profile**

We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst who can sit between US healthcare payer and provider business stakeholders and an offshore ETL engineering pod, and turn ambiguous business asks into precise, buildable specifications. The role spans requirement elicitation, source-to-target mapping, business validation logic, UAT ownership, and stakeholder-facing reporting across an enterprise data warehouse an enterprise Operational Data Store, and the downstream extract and BI layers.

This is a hands-on analyst role, not a coordination role. You will profile data yourself in SQL, read ETL job logic, and defend your specifications in front of both the business and the development team.

**Key Responsibilities**

Requirement to specification. Elicit requirements from business and clinical stakeholders and convert them into BRDs, functional specifications, source-to-target mapping (STTM) documents, and testable acceptance criteria that developers can build from without re-interpretation.

Source-to-target mapping and impact analysis. Produce and maintain mapping and business-requirement documentation for data extracts, including impact analysis for schema, entity, and source-system changes.

Business validation (BV) logic. Define the Landing Zone to Persistent Layers reconciliation and business validation rules executed by the ETL BV framework, and investigate count and value mismatches jointly with the development team.

Data analysis and profiling. Write and tune complex SQL to profile source data, validate transformation logic, quantify defect impact, and answer stakeholder data questions independently.

Reporting and visualization. Partner with BI developers on Tableau / Power BI dashboard requirements, wireframes, and metric definitions; validate published outputs against the agreed source of truth.

Release and UAT ownership. Drive UAT planning, test-scenario definition, defect triage, and business sign-off across Dev / QA / UAT / Production cycles, including regulatory submission windows.

Stakeholder management. Run requirement workshops and status reviews with US-based business owners across time zones; surface risks, dependencies, and scope ambiguity early rather than at test time.

Documentation and governance. Maintain runbooks, known-issue articles, data dictionaries, and end-to-end traceability from requirement through to the deployed object.

Required Qualifications

8 10 years of total experience, including a minimum of 4 5 years as a Business Analyst or Data Analyst in the US healthcare domain payer side (claims, enrollment, membership, provider, benefits, capitation, pharmacy) and/or provider side (EMR / clinical data).

Demonstrated ability to convert client requirements into formal business documents BRD / FSD, STTM, use cases, process flows, and requirement traceability matrices.

Strong data warehousing fundamentals — dimensional modelling, slowly changing dimensions, CDC / delta processing, landing–staging–persistent layering, data lineage, reconciliation, and data quality management.

Excellent written and verbal English and the confidence to lead a workshop with senior US stakeholders.

***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

***Innovate with Tether***

**Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

Tether Wallet is our self-custodial wallet, built to bring USDT and XAUT directly to the people who rely on Tether every day, especially in markets where access to stable money and savings is hardest. For that to work, getting into these assets has to be simple, fast and affordable. Our goal is to give every Tether Wallet user the best option to exchange any local currency or token into USDT and XAUT, wherever they are.

In this role, you will define and own the strategy for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT across our target markets. You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. You will own the outcome end to end, from the first partner evaluation through integration and the in-app experience to the conversion numbers after launch. If you enjoy turning a fragmented global payments landscape into a buy button that just works, we want to hear from you.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Buy & Swap Strategy: Define and own the strategy and roadmap for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT in Tether Wallet, covering fiat on-ramps, card payments, local payment methods and token-to-token swaps.
* Market & Payment Landscape: Work with our expansion teams to build a deep understanding of each target market, including dominant payment methods, card schemes, bank transfer and instant payment rails, mobile money, local regulation, and the on-ramp and swap providers active there.
* Partner Evaluation & Selection: Define clear evaluation criteria such as market and payment method coverage, fees and FX spreads, approval and conversion rates, KYC experience, settlement speed, reliability and compliance standing, and use them to select the best on-ramp or swap partner for each market.
* Partner Onboarding: Lead selected partners from evaluation to go-live as service partners of Tether Wallet, coordinating with Legal, Compliance and Business Development on due diligence, commercial terms and contracts.
* Integration & Delivery: Translate partner capabilities and APIs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering and design to deliver a seamless in-app buy and swap experience.
* Routing & Optimization: Define the logic that decides which partner and payment method a user is offered based on country, currency, amount, price and availability, so every user gets the best available option.
* Performance & Partner Management: Define and track KPIs across the buy and swap funnel, such as conversion, payment approval rates, KYC drop-off, total cost to the user and volume by market and partner. Use the data to improve the experience, manage partner performance and incidents, and regularly review whether each market still has the right partner.

* 3+ years of product management experience in DeFi or crypto industry
* Good understanding of crypto wallets and DeFi features, including token swaps, DEX aggregators and on-chain transaction flows.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Sabre Payments
jobs.description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

We are seeking a Principal Product Manager to join our global Sabre Payments team, where innovation knows no borders. The Sabre Payments Product team is dedicated to modernizing how the global travel ecosystem buys, sells and settles transactions by building enterprise-grade, high-availability payment orchestration platforms. As Principal Product Manager, you will lead the strategic vision, architecture and execution of Sabre’s next-generation Travel Payout Platform, enabling airlines, agencies, hotels and travel operators to disburse funds globally.

  

This role directly aligns with Sabre’s core business strategy to expand beyond distribution and retail into high-margin fintech infrastructure and automated B2B financial workflows. By bridging legacy travel bookings with modern multi-rail payment networks, you will drive new revenue streams and establish Sabre as the definitive B2B payout hub for the travel industry. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity and commitment so we can all win together.

  

As Principal Product Manager, you will lead platform execution and establish high-throughput financial infrastructure across global markets. You will bridge complex technical architecture with high-stakes commercial strategy, collaborating with engineering, external financial partners and enterprise clients. This role requires deep domain mastery in fintech and B2B payout orchestration, clear commercial acumen and the confidence to challenge legacy settlement processes.

  

**What you'll do**

* Establish the multi-year product vision, strategic positioning and financial business cases for the platform, taking end-to-end accountability for gross disbursement volume (GDV), platform take rates and product ROI.
* Lead high-stakes product and technical evaluations with external payment partners, including virtual card issuing platforms, premium regional issuers and cross-border bank networks, to structure optimal rebate-sharing models, SLA guarantees and integration frameworks.
* Drive the end-to-end product development lifecycle from initial MVP scoping through enterprise rollout, defining high-value feature prioritization, RESTful API specifications and architectural requirements alongside engineering leadership.
* Serve as the authoritative product voice across sales leadership, legal, risk and compliance teams to ensure alignment on regulatory standards (KYB/AML, PCI-DSS), commercial strategy and enterprise customer readiness.
* Define North Star product performance indicators, build telemetry frameworks for transaction routing and reconciliation, and establish operating models with dedicated customer support and exception-handling teams.
Use generative artificial intelligence, automation and agentic flows to optimize platform routing intelligence, automate product planning and accelerate feature delivery.  

  

**What you'll bring**

  

Required qualifications

* Minimum 10 years of senior product management experience owning, scaling and managing complex multi-sided enterprise technology platforms, RESTful API products or high-throughput transaction engines from concept through commercial rollout.
* Strategic platform and API-first product ownership experience, with demonstrated expertise in defining technical platform architectures, platform routing logic and developer-centric capabilities.
* Commercial and data-driven business acumen, including the proven capability to define product unit economics, build financial business cases, analyze complex operational data and structure strategic commercial relationships.
* Executive presence and stakeholder management skills, with a history of influencing cross-functional engineering, legal, risk and commercial teams, as well as presenting product vision to internal leadership and enterprise client executives.
* Practical experience applying generative artificial intelligence, automation or analytics tools to enhance platform capabilities and team productivity.

Preferred qualifications

* Background in commercial fintech, B2B payment orchestration, card issuing, merchant acquiring or travel technology systems (e.g., GDS, booking engines, settlement networks).

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

* Significant ownership of an AI-first product at the center of how sellers work.
* A global product used by enterprise revenue teams worldwide, built by a product team in India.
* A best-in-class design team to learn from.

**Our Culture & Values**
------------------------

We hire builders, people who move fast, learn from failure, and use AI as a default part of how they work. Our values- Delight Your Customers, Act as a Founder, and Better Together- aren't wall decor. They're how we make decisions here.

Growth at Mindtickle looks like owning more, not just doing more. Your scope will outgrow your job title if you want it to. You'll work alongside people who've scaled revenue tech globally, get direct feedback from leaders invested in your development, and take on challenges before you feel ready because that's how the best growth happens.

Our team spans 5+ countries, backgrounds, and perspectives. We believe the best products are built by people who bring different ways of seeing the same problem - and everyone has a seat at that table.

We hire for potential. Apply even if your experience doesn't match every requirement; your skills, perspective, and drive matter here. At Mindtickle, you can be yourself, build your career, and do the best work of your life alongside people who genuinely want to see you succeed.

We believe the best products are built by teams with different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of seeing the world. We welcome every unique identity, and we mean that.

.

**Your Qualifications:**

jobs.title: Interesting Job Opportunity: Justdial - Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a highly analytical and user-centric Senior Product Manager to spearhead the strategic and behavioral evolution of our core search engine platform across web browsers. In this role, your primary mission is to convert massive top-of-funnel browsing traffic into meaningful, high-intent leads for our paid clients and advertisers, while simultaneously deepening daily user engagement.
  
  
Rather than a traditional transaction/payment engine, you will focus on booking capacity and intent fulfillment. This means defining and building frictionless, zero-payment booking loopssuch as reserving slots, scheduling appointments, or checking real-time availabilityeither through seamless third-party API integrations or native platform capabilities on Justdial. This role sits at the intersection of browser technology, consumer psychology, and lead-generation architecture.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Generation & Funnel Optimization: Design and execute a product roadmap aimed strictly at increasing user engagement and converting casual browser searchers into high-intent leads for advertisers.
* Fulfillment & Booking Capabilities: Own the strategy and execution for zero-payment booking loops (e.g., appointment scheduling, slot reservations). Architect these experiences smoothly using both native systems and third-party partner integrations.
* Browser Experience Ownership: Act as the internal expert on browser technology, optimizing site speed, discoverability, user paths, and interactive modules across all major web browsers.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Engineering, UX/UI Design, Marketing, and Business Development to translate user intent into highly scannable, engaging search results pages that prompt action.
* Data & Intent Analytics: Move beyond surface-level clicks to analyze deeper behavioral signals. Utilize user data and search patterns to design algorithmic intent-matching and vendor response-time metrics.
* Product Delivery: Translate business requirements into crisp PRDs (Product Requirement Documents) and technical logic, collaborating daily with engineering teams for on-time, high-quality Experience & Browser Depth:
* 6 to 7 years of product management experience, with a proven track record of successfully managing and optimizing high-volume, consumer-facing web or search products.
* Deep experience working on browser platforms, with an intimate understanding of web technologies, browser performance limits, and user behaviors across different browsers.
* Prior experience in search engine technology, lead-generation platforms, online directories, or high-traffic consumer internet spaces is a major plus.

**Funnel Rigor & Lead Monetization Mindset**

* Exceptional data-driven mindset with strong analytical skills to map out user drop-offs and design hooks that capture intent earlier in the browsing journey.
* Familiarity with building or managing performance metrics that benefit advertisers (e.g., lead quality, response speed tracking, etc).

**Technical Empathy & Integration Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. An MBA or advanced degree is preferred.
* Solid understanding of web architectures and API orchestrations (crucial for linking third-party booking systems natively into our browser interface) is a plus.

**Communication & Strategic Execution**

* Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly convey product vision to design and engineering teams, as well as business stakeholders.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to think creatively, distill vague customer problems into clear UI/UX patterns, and drive initiatives from concept to launch.

**Performance Indicators (Success Metrics)**

* Primary: High-Intent Lead Volume (Generated for paid clients), Search-to-Lead/Booking Conversion Rate, Browser-Based User Engagement & Retention.
* Secondary: Partner API Success/Latency Rates, Booking Fulfillment Completion (Successful slot reservations), Lead Quality/Accuracy Scores.

**Why Join Us**
Joining Justdial Ltd means working on a product that impacts millions of users in India daily. Youll have the opportunity to re-engineer core search experiences on the web, design next-generation lead capture loops that directly impact the revenue of thousands of local businesses, and work alongside a talented, fast-paced team. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a vibrant work culture that rewards ownership and creative execution.
